annotations.grafana.app/message: fix infra overview aria SQL query

spec.rawSql: SELECT datastore_data, percent_use FROM datastore_usage WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '1 hour' ORDER BY percent_use DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT datastore_data, type, total_capacity, space_use, free_space, percent_use FROM datastore_usage WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '1 hour' ORDER BY percent_use DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) as count FROM unity_metrics WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND unity_metrics."sizeTotal" IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cluster_id) as count FROM powerstore_performance WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND entity = 'space_metrics_by_cluster'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT node_id) as count FROM powerstore_performance WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND entity = 'performance_metrics_by_node'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT appliance_id) as count FROM powerstore_performance WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND entity = 'performance_metrics_by_appliance'

SELECT datacenter, summary_total_number_vms
FROM vm_inventory
WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT SUM("vmop_inventoryChange_numCreate_latest") as created FROM vm_inventory WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
SELECT SUM("vmop_inventoryChange_numDestroy_latest") as destroyed FROM vm_inventory WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
SELECT time, datacenter, cpu_workload, mem_workload FROM system_metrics WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY time
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT datastore_data) as count FROM datastore_usage WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT SUM(total_capacity) * 1073741824 as total_bytes FROM datastore_usage WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT AVG(percent_use) as avg_percent FROM datastore_usage WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
